duplicate_source_policy: If both source variants produce exactly equal full targets with the same execution bundle, group before returns and compute once per policy/cost, retaining aliases. Otherwise evaluate both without selecting a source winner.
failure_policy: Execution/audit errors retain failed source and actual partial output; metrics unknown until verified. Version technical repairs separately without changing economic rules. Negative economic finding closes branch; no direction/window/risk tuning.
unseen_and_external: No new unseen or third-party evidence. Prepare reproducible raw-to-cash records; external review, truly unseen validation and actual execution remain separate unfinished gates.
